tokentrim 80% budget alert

tokentrim lets you see when your Claude Code token usage reaches 80 % of your daily limit. The free dashboard shows a clear alert so you can stop or adjust your session before you hit the cap.

How the 80 % budget alert works

  1. Install tokentrim as a plugin or clone the full repo.
  2. Run your Claude Code sessions normally.
  3. The dashboard tracks token usage in real time.
  4. When usage hits 80 % of the set daily budget, an alert appears.
  5. You can pause or modify the session to stay within limits.

What you get

  • All hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold‑cache alert are free.
  • Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80 %, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.
  • Nothing leaves your machine unless you choose to share data.

FAQ

What does the 80 % alert do? It notifies you when your daily token usage reaches 80 % of the set budget, helping you avoid unexpected charges.

Do I need a paid plan to see the alert? No. The alert is part of the free dashboard. Paid plans add extra alerts and reporting.

Can I change the alert threshold? Yes. The dashboard lets you set any percentage you prefer.
